source.basis: Operator spec page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
The Allen campus publishes 77 MW of IT capacity across three facility codes, DFW3 through DFW5, in roughly 976,000 square feet of technical space. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 77 MW supports approximately 1,925 racks; at 10 kW per rack, a legacy colocation assumption, the same power reaches roughly 7,700 racks. The honest range is wide, and CyrusOne has not published a rack count or a per-rack density figure for this campus.

The certifications tell you what classes of workload the campus is qualified to host. PCI DSS qualifies it for payment card data. HIPAA qualifies it for regulated health information. ISO 27001 and SSAE 16 Type II are audited security and controls frameworks that enterprise and government procurement processes commonly require. FISMA qualifies it for federal government workloads. Green Globes is an environmental performance rating, not a security or compliance credential.

Among the 133 Texas facilities this site has mapped, only 8 have published a megawatt figure, and their combined total is 315 MW. At 77 MW, this campus is the second largest by published IT capacity in that group, representing roughly 24 percent of the published Texas total this site has read. That ranking reflects only what operators have chosen to publish, not the true distribution of capacity across the state.
